title: ForeignKeyDescription getting references from another schema with same table names
body:
Hello,
I would like suggest a correction in file 

src\Database\Schema\PostgresSchema.php

``` php
public function describeForeignKeySql($tableName, $config) line 278

$sql = "SELECT
            rc.constraint_name AS name,
            tc.constraint_type AS type,
            kcu.column_name,
            rc.match_option AS match_type,
            rc.update_rule AS on_update,
            rc.delete_rule AS on_delete,

            kc.table_name AS references_table,
            kc.column_name AS references_field

            FROM information_schema.referential_constraints rc

            JOIN information_schema.table_constraints tc
                ON tc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
                AND tc.constraint_schema = rc.constraint_schema
                AND tc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name

            JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
                ON kcu.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
                AND kcu.constraint_schema = rc.constraint_schema
                AND kcu.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name

            JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kc
                ON kc.ordinal_position = kcu.position_in_unique_constraint
                AND kc.constraint_name = rc.unique_constraint_name

            WHERE kcu.table_name = ?
              AND kc.table_schema = ?
              AND tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'

            ORDER BY rc.constraint_name, kcu.ordinal_position"; 

```

Is looking for references from other scheme, with the same table names

example

``` sql
CREATE SCHEMA schema1;

CREATE TABLE schema1.types
(
  id serial NOT NULL,
  type character varying(20),
  CONSTRAINT types_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE schema1.contacts
(
  id serial NOT NULL,
  name integer,
  type_id integer,
  CONSTRAINT contacts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT fkey_contacts_type_id FOREIGN KEY (type_id)
      REFERENCES schema1.types (id) MATCH SIMPLE
      ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL
);


CREATE SCHEMA schema2;

CREATE TABLE schema2.typesofcontacts
(
  id serial NOT NULL,
  type character varying(20),
  CONSTRAINT types_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE schema2.contacts
(
  id serial NOT NULL,
  name integer,
  type_id_blah integer,
  CONSTRAINT contacts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT fkey_contacts_typesofcontacts_id FOREIGN KEY (type_id_blah)
      REFERENCES schema2.typesofcontacts (id) MATCH SIMPLE
      ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL
);

```

result of sql
"fkey_contacts_type_id";"FOREIGN KEY";"type_id";"NONE";"CASCADE";"SET NULL";"types";"id"
"fkey_contacts_typesofcontacts_id";"FOREIGN KEY";"type_id_blah";"NONE";"CASCADE";"SET NULL";"types";"id"

this raise a database exception error "Columns used in constraints must be added to the Table schema first.";

correction

add to where clause
 AND kcu.table_schema = ? 

return this
"fkey_contacts_type_id";"FOREIGN KEY";"type_id";"NONE";"CASCADE";"SET NULL";"types";"id"

proceeds?

thank you!
